## 维护者速读

- 用户无感:车队内部工具的输出与几份派发规则参考页改了措辞,只有派发席位读到。
- 属于「把手抄流程改成脚本」那张收口卡(第 8 片),替各席位把过时的说法对齐到现行席位规则。
- 措辞错了只会误导席位读者,不影响任何产品行为,整个 PR 可直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

- **Item 3, `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`.** The `--tier` output no longer prints "a hit outside the spec lane is spec-lane work and moves there". With the domain seats retired, the clause-② note now says a contract-surface hit no longer moves the card and that build and review stay with the claiming seat; the suspicion line says the same ("both by the claiming seat"), and the `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` docblock follows. Two self-test pins in `dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs` move to the new wording and pin the retired sentence absent.
- **Item 5 (and item 10's N6), `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs` + `references/contract-review.md`.** The `Contract-review-handoff:` template placeholder now offers the live target spellings, l2-review#N, repo:NAME#N and epic:#N#k, instead of the retired domain-seat spelling (still read by `HANDOFF_TARGET`, no longer offered). Template and rule text move in one edit; the verbatim pin holds. The comment on the constant is rewritten (N6), and a new self-test case fills in every target shape the template offers and reads it back through the reader.
- **Item 6, `references/seat-lifecycle.md`.** The round rule line (开轮互斥) now carries the round length, 60 minutes, the number `round-open.mjs` reads as `ROUND_MINUTES`.
- **Item 11.** `cross-repo-coordination.md`, `lanes/security.md`, `readings-queue.md` and `readings-shell.md` no longer spell raw `merge-base --is-ancestor`; each points at `git-history.mjs ancestor`.

Byte deltas on the ratcheted files (`wc -c`, base 0e361201 → head), all net ≤ 0, no ceiling row touched:

| file | before | after | delta |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|
| `references/contract-review.md` | 6418 | 6418 | 0 |
| `references/seat-lifecycle.md` | 9054 | 9052 | -2 |
| `references/cross-repo-coordination.md` | 4905 | 4903 | -2 |
| `references/lanes/security.md` | 4240 | 4236 | -4 |
| `references/readings-queue.md` | 9074 | 9067 | -7 |
| `references/readings-shell.md` | 2492 | 2490 | -2 |

Paid by deletion in the same file: `contract-review.md` drops 请谁 before the l2-review pointer; `seat-lifecycle.md` shortens "fire 开始、首个写动作之前" and the `check-harness-current.mjs` path; `cross-repo-coordination.md` folds the pin-sha clause and drops 那张; `readings-shell.md` drops 上 and rewords the 127 line's tail.

Read first, by risk:
1. `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`, `tierLines` (the clause-② note and the suspicion line): it is quoted into claim comments.
2. `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs`, `CONTRACT_REVIEW_HANDOFF_TEMPLATE` and the new self-test case after "the TEMPLATE sent verbatim is unreadable".
3. `references/seat-lifecycle.md` line 5.

## Tests

All readings on head `0148d307f0` (`git rev-parse --short HEAD`), after the last commit.

- `node scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs --self-test`: exit 0, "467 cases pass" (the new template-shape case included).
- `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates`: exit 0, "dispatch-gates self-test (fast tier): 2369 cases pass; 9 slow section(s) deferred" (the slow tier is CI's on schedule/push).
- `pnpm check:pm-prior-rulings`: exit 0 ("round-open self-test: 37 cases pass across 6 batteries"): the round-open phrase pins on `seat-lifecycle.md` and `contract-review.md` still hold.
- `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `check:pm-governed-prose`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:pm-record-recognisers`, `check:pm-half-states`, `check:nul-bytes`: exit 0 each.

<details><summary>Reverse verification (both new pins fail on the old text)</summary>

- `record-recognisers.mjs`: in a throwaway worktree at this head, the template and its rule-text copy were put back to the retired domain-seat placeholder; the self-test went red on exactly the new case ("every target shape the TEMPLATE offers, filled in, READS"), 1 of 467, exit 1. Worktree removed.
- `dispatch-gates.mjs`: the two rewritten pin expressions, evaluated against `tierLines` imported from this head and from base `0e361201`: `{"pin1":true,"pin2":true}` on the head, `{"pin1":false,"pin2":false}` on the base.
</details>

<details><summary>Derived gate families (dispatch-gates --commands, 70 families)</summary>

- 68 of 70 exit 0 on the first pass.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions`: exit 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET (formula and lint not built) on the first pass; after `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint` under the verify lock (VERDICT command-exit 0), re-run: exit 0.
- `pnpm check:i18n-coverage`: exit 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET (the workspace CLI and 15 example/plugin packages not built). NOT MEASURED locally, reason: the build closure is unrelated to this diff (no i18n surface touched) and heavy on a shared box; declared narrowing, CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` runs it.
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: "70 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 70 run".
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Item 6 is half done on purpose.** The round length now sits on the `seat-lifecycle.md` rule line. `contract-review.md`'s 「一轮(约 60 分钟)」 stays, because `round-open.mjs` pins that phrase there (`ROUND_PHRASE` / `CONTRACT_REVIEW_PATH`, its self-test, and its docblock), and `round-open.mjs` is outside this slice (item 7). To finish item 6, the item-7 edit moves the pin to the `seat-lifecycle.md` line and then drops the figure from `contract-review.md`. Carrier: #35237.
- **Stale after this PR, outside the slice surface (carrier: #35237, not filed):** `references/execution-duties.md` (强制条款② line) still says `--tier` 仍印 the spec-lane sentence as residual script wording, and that sentence no longer prints. `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.data.mjs` (the clause-② docblock in the tier-glob header) still says a hit outside the spec lane is lane routing that moves there. `references/area-lease.md` (留道 line) still ranks the seat ahead of the `--tier` 提示 to move lanes, and that hint is gone too.
- The old `review#N` and the retired domain-seat spelling are still READ by `HANDOFF_TARGET`; only the template stops offering the retired one. Reader behaviour is unchanged.
- `Rule-change: none`: each edit makes the text match a rule or reading that has already landed (the retired domain seats, the hand-off reader's target set, `ROUND_MINUTES`, `git-history.mjs ancestor`). What an agent may do, and in what order, is unchanged. `dispatch-gates.mjs` keeps the whole PR at Tier H either way.
- Not published: `scripts/pm/**` and `.claude/**` only. `skip-changeset`.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --tier packages/spec/src/data/filter.zod.ts` prints "a contract-surface hit no longer moves the card — build and review stay with the claiming seat" and no "spec-lane work"; `node scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs --self-test` passes.
